hero.name: Taha Naghdi
hero.description: Cinematographer, editor, and cinematic content creator specializing in lighting, motion graphics, AI-driven media, and digital strategy. As a full-stack developer fluent in 3 languages and modern frameworks, I build intelligent AI agents and web apps, alongside engineering industrial automation and innovative hardware gadgets.

about.title: About
about.shortBio: Filmmaker, editor, and developer bridging cinematic storytelling with cutting-edge technology. From cinematic video production and motion graphics to developing intelligent AI agents, modern web applications, and industrial automation, my focus is delivering high-impact media and precise engineering solutions.

expandedBio.p1: I design visual media and software systems driven by high aesthetic standards, cinematic creativity, and rigorous engineering. My core background spans cinematography, advanced editing, cinematic lighting, and dynamic motion graphics, seamlessly integrated with modern generative AI production and digital content strategy.
expandedBio.p2: In software engineering, I am fluent in 3 programming languages and leading web frameworks, building intelligent autonomous AI agents, AI-powered products, and responsive web applications. I focus on clean architecture, intuitive user experiences, and robust scalability.
expandedBio.p3: In hardware and IoT, I architect and build practical automation systems for retail and industrial environments, creating tailored gadgets that optimize real-world operations.
expandedBio.p4: My ultimate mission is fusing evocative visual storytelling, artificial intelligence, and software craftsmanship into innovative solutions that make a tangible difference.
